_doc: The INLINE-STRUCTURE template (2026-10-31): the deck states the cell itself instead of naming a materials.json entry -- the door a GUI uses
for a cell the user built.  This one is Si_diamond's entry copied verbatim plus a 'name' (it names the revisions: Si_diamond_inline.rNNN.json),
so it IS Si_diamond: UTCalculation Deck.AnInlineDeckAndItsNamedTwinBuildTheSameFingerprint.  Give 'structure' OR 'inlineStructure', never both.
